page.overview:
Who is Glenda?

Being a girl of just six years old, she amazed the inhabitants of her hometown with one of the most sophisticated helicopters. When her father died heroically, Glenda swore to continue fighting for his noble cause. Today she is an Air Intelligence Officer, Helicopter Copilot on high-risk missions. She is the first woman to be designated Master G.I. Joe Instructor.

Glenda led Hardball and Rampart in a mission to capture Asa Negra and Big Boa, only to find both Cobra members and their troops dead. Glenda noticed how unlikely it was to be the work of local warlords or the CIA, and that whoever did it was sending a message. Those who did it revealed themselves, confirmed Glenda's suspicions, and killed the three Joes to complete the message.

Glenda (or possibly 25th Ann. pilot Scarlett (V10)) appears on one of 3 identical alternate covers for G.I. Joe: A Real American Hero #256. The other two covers feature Classic Scarlett and Ninja Force Scarlett.

Glenda was an exclusive figure that was available carded in Argentina by the Plastirama toy company.
